results.question: What is the total revenue across all completed orders?
results.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' LIMIT 101

results.question: What is the average order value for delivered orders?
results.generated_sql: SELECT AVG(sub.order_total) AS average_order_value FROM (SELECT o.id AS id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS order_total FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY o.id) AS sub LIMIT 101

results.question: How many total items have been purchased across all orders?
results.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_items FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' LIMIT 101

results.question: What is the minimum and maximum product price in our catalog?
results.generated_sql: SELECT MIN(products.unit_price) AS min_price, MAX(products.unit_price) AS max_price FROM products AS products LIMIT 101

results.question: How many unique customers have placed at least one order?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT orders.customer_id) AS active_customer_count FROM orders AS orders WHERE orders.status <> 'cancelled' LIMIT 101

results.question: What is the total amount of all successful payments?
results.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(payments.amount) AS total_successful_payments FROM payments AS payments WHERE payments.status = 'completed' LIMIT 101

results.question: What is the total revenue broken down by customer region?
results.generated_sql: SELECT c.region AS region, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, region ASC LIMIT 101

results.question: Count the total number of orders by fulfillment status.
results.generated_sql: SELECT orders.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders AS orders GROUP BY orders.status ORDER BY order_count DESC, status ASC LIMIT 101

results.question: What is the average product unit price in each category?
results.generated_sql: SELECT products.category AS category, ROUND(CAST(AVG(products.unit_price) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_unit_price FROM products AS products GROUP BY products.category ORDER BY avg_unit_price DESC, category ASC LIMIT 101

results.question: List product categories that have generated more than $10,000 in revenue.
results.generated_sql: SELECT p.category AS category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.category HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) > 10000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, category ASC LIMIT 101

results.question: How many customers registered in each geographical region?
results.generated_sql: SELECT customers.region AS region, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers AS customers GROUP BY customers.region ORDER BY customer_count DESC, region ASC LIMIT 101

results.question: What is the total revenue and order count for each payment method?
results.generated_sql: SELECT payments.method AS method, SUM(payments.amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM payments AS payments GROUP BY payments.method ORDER BY total_amount DESC, method ASC LIMIT 101

results.question: What are the top 5 best-selling products by quantity?
results.generated_sql: SELECT p.name AS name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, name ASC LIMIT 5

results.question: Who are the top 3 customers by total spend?
results.generated_sql: SELECT c.name AS name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spend FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_spend DESC, name ASC LIMIT 3

results.question: What is the single most expensive product in inventory?
results.generated_sql: SELECT products.name AS name, products.unit_price AS unit_price FROM products AS products ORDER BY unit_price DESC, name ASC LIMIT 1

results.question: What are the top 3 product categories by revenue?
results.generated_sql: SELECT p.category AS category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, category ASC LIMIT 3

results.question: Find the 5 most recent orders placed in the system.
results.generated_sql: SELECT orders.id AS id, orders.customer_id AS customer_id, orders.order_date AS order_date, orders.status AS status FROM orders AS orders ORDER BY order_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: What was the total revenue generated in October 2024?
results.generated_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2024-10-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-11-01' LIMIT 101

results.question: How many orders were placed in the last 30 days?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders AS orders WHERE orders.order_date >= '2024-10-02' AND orders.order_date <= '2024-11-01' LIMIT 101

results.question: How many customers signed up between June 1, 2024 and August 31, 2024?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers AS customers WHERE customers.signup_date >= '2024-06-01' AND customers.signup_date <= '2024-08-31' LIMIT 101

results.question: Show monthly order counts for the year 2024.
results.generated_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders AS orders WHERE orders.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND orders.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) ORDER BY order_month ASC LIMIT 101

results.question: Compare revenue in October 2024 versus September 2024.
results.generated_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', o.order_date) AS order_month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS monthly_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2024-09-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-11-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', o.order_date) ORDER BY order_month ASC LIMIT 101

results.question: How many orders are currently placed or shipped but not yet delivered?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS undelivered_count FROM orders AS orders WHERE orders.status IN ('placed', 'shipped') LIMIT 101

results.question: List all customers located in the EMEA region.
results.generated_sql: SELECT customers.id AS id, customers.name AS name, customers.email AS email FROM customers AS customers WHERE customers.region = 'EMEA' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 101

results.question: Show all products priced over $100.
results.generated_sql: SELECT products.id AS id, products.name AS name, products.category AS category, products.unit_price AS unit_price FROM products AS products WHERE products.unit_price > 100 ORDER BY unit_price DESC, id ASC LIMIT 101

results.question: How many orders are currently cancelled?
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_order_count FROM orders AS orders WHERE orders.status = 'cancelled' LIMIT 101

results.question: List all orders placed on November 1, 2024.
results.generated_sql: SELECT orders.id AS id, orders.customer_id AS customer_id, orders.status AS status FROM orders AS orders WHERE orders.order_date = '2024-11-01' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 101

results.question: Show order ID, customer name, and order date for the 50 most recent placed orders.
results.generated_sql: SELECT o.id AS id, c.name AS name, o.order_date AS order_date FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.status = 'placed' ORDER BY o.order_date DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT 50

results.question: List each product name alongside its total units sold.
results.generated_sql: SELECT p.name AS name, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.id IS NOT NULL THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_units_sold FROM products AS p LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.id AND o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC, name ASC LIMIT 101

results.question: Which customers have never placed any orders?
results.generated_sql: SELECT c.id AS id, c.name AS name, c.email AS email FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.id IS NULL ORDER BY c.id ASC LIMIT 101

results.question: Show payment methods breakdown by total collected amount.
results.generated_sql: SELECT payments.method AS method, SUM(payments.amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM payments AS payments WHERE payments.status = 'completed' GROUP BY payments.method ORDER BY total_amount DESC, method ASC LIMIT 101

results.question: How many payments failed or were refunded?
results.generated_sql: SELECT payments.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM payments AS payments WHERE payments.status IN ('failed', 'refunded') GROUP BY payments.status ORDER BY payment_count DESC, status ASC LIMIT 101
